name: Repeatable standards sheet writer
why: A one-page sheet of checkable standards, the companion to a kitchen standard recipe card so every cook plates it the same way.

name: Restaurant portion cost builder
why: Costs a batch and a portion from the weights on a finished kitchen recipe card.

name: Connect production yield to mix contribution
why: Turns measured batch yield into cost per good unit, useful when a scaled-up bakery recipe goes into production.

name: Blog post publish check loop
why: Checks a finished recipe post's claims and plain wording before it goes live.

name: Customer question keyword finder
why: Turns reader comments and questions into the FAQ section of a recipe post.

name: Store blog plan builder
why: Plans a run of recipe posts for a food shop or brand that point readers to its products.

name: Build a brand file and style guide from scratch
why: Sets the voice rules that sit beside the recipe house style sheet for a food brand or blog.
